title: Microsoft.Entra/policies/tokenLifetimePolicies
description: An access token lifetime policy (tokenLifetimePolicy). The resource name is the displayName; it is looked up by displayName on every run (more than one match is an error). Assigned to applications and service principals with their tokenLifetimePolicies edge.

displayName.description: Set from the resource name; declaring it is only allowed when it equals the name.

definition.description: Required: one policy document, {"TokenLifetimePolicy":{"Version":1,"AccessTokenLifetime":"02:00:00"}}, as a JSON string or (sugar) an object. AccessTokenLifetime is 10 minutes to 1 day; refresh and session token lifetimes are not supported. Compared by JSON content.

isOrganizationDefault.description: Makes the policy the tenant default (only one policy can be). Defaults to false.

permissions.notes: Learn (tokenlifetimepolicy-post-tokenlifetimepolicies, -update, -delete): Policy.ReadWrite.ApplicationConfiguration is the least privileged write permission (delegated and application); tokenlifetimepolicy-list reads with Policy.Read.All. Learn names no role on these pages; Cloud Application Administrator and Application Administrator manage application policies. Assigning the policy (the tokenLifetimePolicies edge) needs Application.ReadWrite.All (Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy for owned objects) and Policy.Read.All instead.
